creatures.name: Xardorok Sunblight
creatures.flav: The self-styled Iron Tyrant of the duergar, a Sunblight fanatic who dreams of dragging Ten-Towns into the dark beneath a chardalyn wing.

acts.name: Enlarge
acts.text: For the duration, Xardorok is Large, his Spiked Gauntlet dice explode, and he has Favor on Might Checks and Saves.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: Xardorok is Invisible until he Attacks, Casts, uses Enlarge, or his Focus breaks.

acts.name: Spiteful Flame
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged by a Being it senses, that Being takes 8 (3d4) Fire damage and is Burning (Cd4).

creatures.name: Chardalyn Dragon
creatures.flav: A dragon-shaped engine of black chardalyn crystal, built by duergar hands and given a stolen dragon's fury. It has no mind of its own to reason with.

acts.name: Tail
acts.text: Target is shoved 15' and Prone.

acts.name: Malevolent Presence
acts.text: Targets are Charmed and fixate on a target of the dragon's choice, moving toward it and Attacking it on their Turn.

acts.name: Chardalyn Breath
acts.text: Bonus burst, not counted in steady DPR.

creatures.name: Arveiaturace
creatures.flav: An ancient white wyrm who has ruled the Reghed Glacier since before Ten-Towns had a name. Duergar sky-priests court her with tribute; everyone else simply prays she stays asleep.

acts.name: Tail
acts.text: Target is shoved 30' and Prone.

acts.name: Glacial Breath
acts.text: Cold damage. Targets are Dazed (Cd6, Speed reduced by 20') if failed. Bonus burst, not counted in steady DPR.

acts.name: Immutable
acts.text: It can't be transformed.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Terror of the Glacier
acts.text: Enemies that see it for the first time, and at the start of their Turns thereafter, must pass [Will] or be Frightened (Cd6).

creatures.name: Chardalyn Berserker
creatures.flav: A duergar or human warrior whose mind was hollowed out and refilled with something else the moment they picked up chardalyn weapons in Xardorok's forges.

acts.name: Chardalyn Flail
acts.text: Target is Sickened until the end of its next Turn if it fails.

acts.name: Chardalyn Madness
acts.text: At the start of its Turn, roll a d6. On a 1, it does nothing but rave to a master that isn't there.

acts.name: Reckless
acts.text: At the start of its Turn, it can gain Favor on its melee Attacks this Turn, but Attacks against it have Favor until its next Turn.

creatures.name: Ice Troll
creatures.flav: A troll that has made its peace with the Everlasting Rime, growing a hide of rime-frost and a hatred of warmth to match its hatred of everything else.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: Target has Hinder on Attacks until the end of its next Turn if it takes this damage.

acts.name: Cold Aura
acts.text: Any Being that starts its Turn within Close takes this damage.

acts.name: Lesser Regenerate II
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns unless it took damage it was Weak to in the last Round. It can't be reduced below 1 HP except by damage it is Weak to.

creatures.name: Goliath Werebear (Toji)
creatures.flav: A goliath cursed - or blessed - with the spirit of the great bear. Fiercely protective of Icewind Dale's few remaining innocents.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: A Humanlike hit by this must pass [Endure] or be cursed with werebear lycanthropy.

acts.name: Stone's Endurance
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged, reduce the damage taken by 8 (d12+2).

creatures.name: Grandolpha Muzgardt
creatures.flav: A duergar witch of dubious loyalty who trades secrets, poisons, and polymorphs for coin - or for a favor she'll collect on later.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: Grandolpha is Invisible until she Attacks or Casts a Spell that deals damage.

acts.name: Hidebound
acts.text: Grandolpha gains 3 Armor for the duration.

acts.name: Sculpt Flesh
acts.text: As the Polymorph Spell, Targeting only herself.

creatures.name: Auril, the Frostmaiden (First Form)
creatures.flav: The goddess of winter's cruelty, wearing a shape of frost-feathers and talons. She cannot truly die here - only be driven from one mask into the next.

acts.name: Talons
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Touch of Frost
acts.text: Target can't take Reactions until the start of its next Turn.

acts.name: Divine Rejuvenation
acts.text: When reduced to 0 HP, Auril's body melts away and she reappears at full HP in her Second Form within Near.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Auril, the Frostmaiden (Second Form)
creatures.flav: Stripped of her first mask, Auril rises as a knight carved from glacier ice, morningstar in hand and murder in her unreadable face.

acts.name: Ice Morningstar
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Frost Nova
acts.text: Any Being within Close takes this Cold damage when Auril is struck in melee (no Action).

acts.name: Cone of Cold
acts.text: Bonus burst, not counted in steady DPR.

acts.name: Ice Stasis
acts.text: Target must pass [Will] or become Restrained and Vulnerable in an ice crystal, taking 21 (6d6) Cold damage at the start of each of its Turns until it breaks free or the crystal (0 Armor, 9 HP, Immune except Fire) is destroyed.

acts.name: Divine Rejuvenation
acts.text: When reduced to 0 HP, Auril's body shatters and she reappears at full HP in her Third Form within Near.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Auril, the Frostmaiden (Third Form)
creatures.flav: A shard of pure winter, all that's left when the masks come off - and the most dangerous thing Auril has ever been.

acts.name: Frigid Aura
acts.text: Any Being that Ends its Turn within Close takes this Cold damage.

acts.name: Blizzard Veil
acts.text: A 30' radius sphere centered on Auril is heavily obscured for the duration.

acts.name: Divine Resurrection
acts.text: When reduced to 0 HP, Auril's crystalline form shatters and she is gone - until the next winter solstice, when she reappears at full HP somewhere cold and remote.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Frost Giant
creatures.flav: A hulking raider of the Reghed Glacier, patchwork-armored and greataxe-armed, who measures worth in plunder and the size of what it can throw.

creatures.name: Abominable Yeti
creatures.flav: The largest and cruelest of its kind, driven from even the yeti packs of the high Spine for what it did to them.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Chilling Gaze
acts.text: Target within Near that can see it must pass [Endure] or take 21 (6d6) Cold damage and be Paralyzed for 1 Minute, repeating the Save at the end of each of its Turns. On a pass (or the Paralysis ending), it is immune to this Gaze for 1 Hour.

acts.name: Cold Breath
acts.text: Cold damage.

creatures.name: Yeti
creatures.flav: A shaggy, ape-like predator of the high passes above Icewind Dale, more territorial than truly evil.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: plus 9 (2d8) if failed by 5 or more

acts.name: Terror Glare
acts.text: Frightened (Cd4, Paralyzed).

creatures.name: Winter Wolf
creatures.flav: Xardorok's hunting packs range the tundra on four frost-white legs, breath steaming with more than cold.

acts.name: Frost Breath
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Pack Hunter
acts.text: Targets within 5' of one of this Being's Allies are Vulnerable to its attacks.

acts.name: Pounce
acts.text: If it moves at least 20' before an attack on the same Turn, the Target is also knocked Prone if it is Large or smaller.

creatures.name: Vellynne Harpell
creatures.flav: A pragmatic Arcane Brotherhood wizard chasing rumors of Netheril, more interested in what Icewind Dale can teach her than what it can give her.

acts.name: Chill Touch
acts.text: Target can't regain HP until the start of Vellynne's next Turn.

acts.name: Vampiric Touch
acts.text: Vellynne regains HP equal to half the damage dealt.

acts.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
acts.text: Always hits.

creatures.name: Duergar Hammerer
creatures.flav: A duergar strapped into a hulking iron frame of pistons and grinding gears, more machine than dwarf until the frame breaks open.

acts.name: Engine of Pain
acts.text: Once per Turn, an Attacker can target the duergar trapped inside instead, at Hinder. On a hit, the hammerer takes an extra 5 (d10) damage and can Attack immediately as a Reaction.

creatures.name: Gunvald Halraggson
creatures.flav: King of the Tribe of the Bear, a mountain of a man who has never lost a duel and doesn't plan to start.

acts.name: Menacing Blows
acts.text: Deals an extra 6 (d12) damage with a weapon Attack. Target must pass [Will] or be Frightened until the start of Gunvald's next Turn.

acts.name: Second Wind
acts.text: Bonus Action. Gunvald regains 15 HP.

acts.name: Indomitable
acts.text: Gunvald can reroll a failed Save. He must use the new roll.

creatures.name: Snow Golem
creatures.flav: A rough-hewn watchman of packed snow and ice, animated to guard a place or a person until it melts or is ordered otherwise.

acts.name: Slam
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Snowball
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Cold Absorption
acts.text: Whenever the golem is dealt Cold damage, it instead regains that much HP.

creatures.name: Coldlight Walker
creatures.flav: A radiant, frozen corpse that glows with a false dawn - beautiful right up until it turns to look at you.

acts.name: Slam
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Cold Ray
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Blinding Light
acts.text: Bonus Action. Sheds bright light to Near and dim light beyond that. A Being in its bright light must pass [Endure] or be Blinded until the start of the walker's next Turn.

acts.name: Icy Doom
acts.text: A Being it kills freezes solid for 9 Days, during which it can't be thawed, harmed by Fire, animated, or raised from the dead.

creatures.name: Avarice
creatures.flav: A tiefling wizard of the Arcane Brotherhood, chasing power in the ruins beneath the glacier and willing to freeze anyone who gets in her way.

acts.name: Cone of Cold
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Banishing Rebuke
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged by a Being she senses, banish it for 1 Minute to a frigid prison: it is Incapacitated and takes 3 (d10) Cold damage at the start of each of its Turns, repeating a Will Save at the end of each of its Turns to escape early.

creatures.name: Dzaan's Simulacrum
creatures.flav: A frost-pale duplicate of the missing wizard Dzaan, animated by the same magic he used to survive his own death - badly.

acts.name: Shocking Grasp
acts.text: Target can't take Reactions until the start of its next Turn.

acts.name: Magic Missile
acts.text: Always hits.

creatures.name: Duergar Mind Master
creatures.flav: A duergar psion whose dagger hurts less than the thoughts it leaves behind.

acts.name: Mind-Poison Dagger
acts.text: Psychic damage.

acts.name: Mind Mastery
acts.text: Target within Far must pass [Will] or the duergar forces it to Attack another Being it can see, or Move up to 10' in a direction of the duergar's choice, on its Reaction.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: The duergar is Invisible for up to 1 Hour, until it Attacks, Casts, or its Focus breaks.

creatures.name: Icewind Kobold
creatures.flav: A shivering little opportunist that has learned to dig deep and strike from the dark - alone, it's nothing; in a pack, it's a problem.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Target that has one of its Allies within Close.

creatures.name: Kobold Vampire Spawn
creatures.flav: A kobold that crossed the wrong cave in Termalaine's mines and came back changed, hungry, and considerably harder to kill.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: Target's Max HP is reduced by the damage dealt until it finishes a Shift; the vampire spawn heals for the same amount.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Target that has one of its Allies within Close.

acts.name: Lesser Regenerate II
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns unless it took damage it was Weak to in the last Round. It can't be reduced below 1 HP except by damage it is Weak to.

creatures.name: Frost Giant Skeleton
creatures.flav: A frost giant's bones, picked clean by wind and time, still swinging a greataxe for a master it can no longer name.

acts.name: Freezing Stare
acts.text: Target within Far it senses must pass [Endure] or take 17 (5d6) Cold damage and be Paralyzed until the end of its next Turn.

creatures.name: Chwinga
creatures.flav: A tiny nature spirit of Icewind Dale's dwindling wild places, shy, generous, and quick to hide in the nearest stone or stream.

acts.name: Magical Gift
acts.text: Targets a willing Humanlike within Close, who gains a minor supernatural charm (GM's discretion).

acts.name: Natural Shelter
acts.text: It can retreat into a rock, living plant, or natural fresh water in its space (no Action), where it can't be Targeted by anything. It can emerge with an Action.

acts.name: Evasion
acts.text: Checks or Saves it would take half damage on a pass instead take none, and it takes half on a fail.

creatures.name: Jarund Elkhardt
creatures.flav: King of the Tribe of the Elk, who fights with a warhammer in one hand and his shield as a second weapon in the other.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Large or smaller is shoved 5' and Jarund can Move into the space.

acts.name: Brute
acts.text: Jarund's weapon Attacks deal an extra damage die (already included above).

creatures.name: Bjornhild Solvigsdottir
creatures.flav: Queen of the Tribe of the Tiger, who wears Auril's favor like a second edge on her greataxe.

acts.name: Auril's Blessing
acts.text: A weapon Attack that hits deals an extra 11 (2d10) Cold damage.

creatures.name: Isarr Kronenstrom
creatures.flav: Leader of the Tribe of the Wolf in name only - the tribe follows him because they're too afraid to stop.

acts.name: Sickle
acts.text: Deals an extra 13 (2d12) damage if the Target has no Allies within Close.

acts.name: Blood Frenzy
acts.text: It has Favor on melee Attacks against a Target that isn't at full HP.

acts.name: Indomitable
acts.text: Isarr can reroll a failed Save. He must use the new roll.

creatures.name: Demos Magen
creatures.flav: A soldier-shaped construct from the ruins beneath the glacier, built to fight and little else.

acts.name: Fiery End
acts.text: When it dies, its body disintegrates in a harmless burst of fire and smoke, leaving behind anything it carried.

creatures.name: Galvan Magen
creatures.flav: A hovering construct that crackles faintly with stored lightning, built by the Netherese to guard what they couldn't carry.

acts.name: Shocking Touch
acts.text: Shock damage.

acts.name: Static Discharge
acts.text: Shock damage.

acts.name: Fiery End
acts.text: When it dies, its body disintegrates in a harmless burst of fire and smoke, leaving behind anything it carried.

creatures.name: Hypnos Magen
creatures.flav: A construct with silver-glowing eyes, built to talk enemies into laying down their arms - or into far worse ideas.

acts.name: Suggestion
acts.text: Charms the Target into following a reasonable suggestion for the duration. Only works on a Being it can speak to telepathically.

acts.name: Fiery End
acts.text: When it dies, its body disintegrates in a harmless burst of fire and smoke, leaving behind anything it carried.

creatures.name: Verbeeg Longstrider
creatures.flav: A lean, watchful verbeeg who ranges far ahead of its kin, spear in hand and half a dozen quiet spells up its sleeve.

acts.name: Sling
acts.text: Target is Dazed until the end of its next Turn if it fails.

acts.name: Simple Weapon Wielder
acts.text: Its weapon Attacks deal an extra damage die (already included above).

creatures.name: Verbeeg Marauder
creatures.flav: A verbeeg raider who has traded patience for plunder, and isn't shy about which one it enjoys more.

acts.name: Simple Weapon Wielder
acts.text: Its weapon Attacks deal an extra damage die (already included above).

creatures.name: Gnoll Vampire
creatures.flav: A gnoll raider who fed on the wrong corpse in the wrong crypt and rose again craving more.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: Target's Max HP is reduced by the damage dealt until it finishes a Shift; the vampire heals for the same amount.

acts.name: Frightful Cackle
acts.text: Beings of its choice within Far that can hear it must pass [Will] or be Frightened (Cd6).

acts.name: Lesser Regenerate II
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns unless it took damage it was Weak to in the last Round. It can't be reduced below 1 HP except by damage it is Weak to.

creatures.name: Goliath Warrior
creatures.flav: A goliath fighter of the Spine of the World, at home on any cliff face and unbothered by the cold.

acts.name: Stone's Endurance
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged, reduce the damage taken by 9 (d12+3).

creatures.name: Yeti Tyke
creatures.flav: A yeti cub, more curious than dangerous - unless its parents are close, in which case it's not the problem.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: Cold damage.

creatures.name: Nass Lantomir's Ghost
creatures.flav: A Netherese wizard's spirit, still furious about the theft that killed him and still cleverer than most things that will ever threaten you.

acts.name: Horrifying Visage
acts.text: Beings within Far that can see it must pass [Will] or be Frightened (1 Minute); if failed by 5 or more, also aged 1d4x10 years.

acts.name: Possession
acts.text: A Humanlike within Close must pass [Will] or be possessed: it is Incapacitated and the ghost controls its body (using the target's Stats) until the body drops to 0 HP, the ghost ends the possession (no Action), or the ghost is forced out by a Spell like Dispel.

creatures.name: Hengar Aesnvaard
creatures.flav: A militia captain of Bryn Shander, steady in a shield wall and stubborn everywhere else.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Medium or smaller must pass [Might] or be knocked Prone.

acts.name: Parry
acts.text: Reaction. Hengar gains +3 Armor against one melee Attack that would hit him, if he can see the Attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

creatures.name: Mind Flayer
creatures.flav: An alien intellect wrapped in a squid-headed humanoid shape, patient, cruel, and always hungry for something a body can't hold.

acts.name: Tentacles
acts.text: Psychic damage. Target of Medium or smaller is Restrained until it escapes.

acts.name: Mind Blast
acts.text: Psychic damage. Targets are Dazed (1 Minute) if failed.

acts.name: Extract Brain
acts.text: Melee Attack against an Incapacitated Target it has Restrained: 30 (10d6) damage, killing instantly by devouring the brain if this reduces it to 0 HP.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Umber Hulk
creatures.flav: A burrowing horror of chitin and claw, its mandibles alone worse than most things Underdark tunnels produce.

acts.name: Confusing Gaze
acts.text: A Being that starts its Turn within Near and can see its eyes must pass [Will] or be Confused until the start of its next Turn. A Being can avert its eyes to avoid the Save, but then can't see it until its own next Turn.

creatures.name: Myconid Sovereign
creatures.flav: The eldest fungus of its circle, crowned in spore-dust, ruling a patch of glowing mushrooms deep under the Reghed Glacier.

acts.name: Fist
acts.text: Poison damage.

acts.name: Pacifying Spores
acts.text: A Being within Close must pass [Endure] or be Incapacitated (1 Minute), repeating the Save at the end of each of its Turns.

acts.name: Hallucination Spores
acts.text: A Being within Close must pass [Endure] or be Confused (1 Minute), repeating the Save at the end of each of its Turns.

acts.name: Sun Sickness
acts.text: While in sunlight, its Checks and Saves have Hinder, and it dies after 1 Hour in direct sunlight.

creatures.name: Quaggoth
creatures.flav: A shaggy, feral humanoid of the Underdark, more animal instinct than mind, and most dangerous when it's already hurt.

acts.name: Wounded Fury
acts.text: While it has 10 HP or fewer, it has Favor on Attacks and deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage with melee Attacks.

creatures.name: Barbed Devil
creatures.flav: A devil bristling with iron-hard spines, sent up from the Nine Hells whenever Xardorok's ambitions need a longer reach.

acts.name: Barbed Hide
acts.text: At the start of its Turn, any Being Grappling it takes 3 (d10) damage.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Shield Guardian
creatures.flav: A hulking construct bound to a wearer's amulet, absorbing half of what would otherwise kill them - and hitting back twice as hard.

acts.name: Regeneration
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns if it has at least 1 HP.

acts.name: Bound
acts.text: While within Close of its amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian instead.

creatures.name: Spectator
creatures.flav: A small, floating eye-beast summoned to guard a place and never told when to stop.

acts.name: Eye Rays
acts.text: Choose per ray: Confused, Paralyzed, Frightened, or 14 (4d6) damage, each (1 Minute) if failed.

acts.name: Spell Reflection
acts.text: Reaction. If it passes a Save against a Spell, or a Spell Attack misses it, it can redirect the Spell to another Being it senses within Near instead.

creatures.name: Slaad Tadpole
creatures.flav: A wriggling seed of chaos, implanted in some unlucky Being and counting down to a very bad day.

creatures.name: Gnoll
creatures.flav: A hyena-headed raider driven by a demon's hunger, following whoever promises the next meal.

acts.name: Rampage
acts.text: When it reduces a Being to 0 HP with a melee Attack on its Turn, it can Move up to half its Speed and make a Bite Attack, as a Reaction.

creatures.name: Ice Mephit
creatures.flav: A cackling shard of animated ice, more nuisance than threat until it pops.

acts.name: Claws
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Frost Breath
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Death Burst
acts.text: When it dies, Beings within Close must pass [Reflex] or take 4 (d8) damage, half on a pass.

creatures.name: Merrow
creatures.flav: An ogre-kin of the deep water, harpoon in hand and a taste for anything that swims too close.

acts.name: Harpoon
acts.text: Target of Huge or smaller is pulled 20' toward it if it fails an [Might] Save.

creatures.name: Duergar
creatures.flav: A grim, gray-skinned dwarf of Xardorok's rank and file, unhappy to be here and twice as unhappy to see you.

acts.name: Enlarge
acts.text: For the duration, it is Large, and its War Pick dice explode.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: It is Invisible for up to 1 Hour, until it Attacks, Casts, or its Focus breaks.

creatures.name: Reghed Warrior
creatures.flav: A tundra tribesfolk armed with a spear and a lifetime of practice not freezing to death.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Target that has one of its Allies within Close.

creatures.name: Reghed Shaman
creatures.flav: A tribal healer and weather-reader who calls on old spirits when spears aren't enough.

acts.name: Entangle
acts.text: Targets are Restrained for the duration.

acts.name: Barkskin
acts.text: Grants itself or an Ally it touches +2 Armor for the duration.

creatures.name: Reghed Chieftain
creatures.flav: A tribal leader who earned the spear-right the old way, and defends it the same.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Medium or smaller must pass [Might] or be knocked Prone.

acts.name: Parry
acts.text: Reaction. Gains +3 Armor against one melee Attack that would hit it, if it can see the Attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

creatures.name: Reghed Great Warrior
creatures.flav: A tribe's finest fighter, kept close to its leader's side for exactly the reasons you'd expect.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Medium or smaller must pass [Might] or be knocked Prone.

acts.name: Parry
acts.text: Reaction. Gains +3 Armor against one melee Attack that would hit it, if it can see the Attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

creatures.name: Aarakocra
creatures.flav: A bird-folk scout of the high peaks, javelin in talon, most dangerous in a dive.

acts.name: Dive Attack
acts.text: If it Flies at least 30' straight toward a Target before hitting it with a melee Attack, that Attack deals an extra damage die.

creatures.name: Tribal Warrior
creatures.flav: A Reghed or Ten-Towns hunter who fights the way the tundra taught them: in a pack, and without ceremony.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Being that has another of its allies adjacent to it.

creatures.name: Priest
creatures.flav: A servant of Amaunator, Lathander, or whichever god still answers this far north. Ten-Towns keeps them busy.

acts.name: Cure Wounds
acts.text: Restores the listed amount of HP to a Being it touches.

acts.name: Divine Eminence
acts.text: Its next melee Attack this Turn deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

creatures.name: Cult Fanatic
creatures.flav: A true believer of Levistus, drunk on the promise that the Frostmaiden's night will spare the faithful.

acts.name: Command
acts.text: The target must obey a one-word command on its next Turn, so long as the order isn't directly self-destructive.

acts.name: Dark Devotion
acts.text: It has Favor on Saves against being Charmed or Frightened.

creatures.name: Druid
creatures.flav: A keeper of the old green places, which in Icewind Dale means the few that are left.

acts.name: Entangle
acts.text: Targets are Restrained while the growth holds. A target can free itself by passing [Might] on its Turn.

acts.name: Change Shape
acts.text: It transforms into a beast of its size or smaller, and back. Its statistics are unchanged.

creatures.name: Bandit Captain
creatures.flav: Whoever is holding the most knives when the last captain stopped breathing.

acts.name: Parry
acts.text: Reaction. It adds 2 to its Armor against one melee Attack that would hit it. It must see the attacker and be wielding a weapon.

creatures.name: Frost Druid
creatures.flav: A convert to Auril's winter, who has stopped asking the land for anything and started asking the cold instead.

acts.name: Change Shape
acts.text: It transforms into a fox, mountain goat, owl, or wolf, and back. Its statistics are unchanged, but it gains that beast's movement.

acts.name: Cold Blooded
acts.text: It ignores the effects of extreme cold and treats icy ground as normal footing.

creatures.name: Drow Elite Warrior
creatures.flav: A blade of the Underdark, escorting an archmage's business up through the Caves of Hunger and deeply unhappy about the daylight.

acts.name: Hand Crossbow
acts.text: Target must pass [Endure] or be Unconscious (Cd6). The effect ends early if the target takes damage.

acts.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
acts.text: While in sunlight, it has Hinder on Attacks and on sight-based Checks.

creatures.name: Drow Mage
creatures.flav: Patient, poisonous, and entirely certain that everyone in the room is a resource that hasn't been spent yet.

acts.name: Cloudkill
acts.text: The cloud lingers and moves away from the caster each Round. Beings inside it are Sickened.

acts.name: Summon Demon
acts.text: It calls a Shadow Demon to an empty space it can see. The demon acts as its ally and departs after 10 minutes.

acts.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
acts.text: While in sunlight, it has Hinder on Attacks and on sight-based Checks.

creatures.name: Battlehammer Dwarf
creatures.flav: Clan Battlehammer out of Kelvin's Cairn - short, armoured, and utterly unbothered by the walk.

acts.name: Dwarven Resilience
acts.text: It has Favor on Saves against Poison, and resists the effects of extreme cold.

creatures.name: Half-Ogre
creatures.flav: An ogrillon: too clever to be an ogre, too large to be welcome anywhere else.

creatures.name: Goblin Boss
creatures.flav: Izobai, or whoever knifed Izobai. Karkolohk's chain of command is short and frequently revised.

acts.name: Redirect Attack
acts.text: Reaction. When a Being it can see hits it with an Attack, it swaps places with an adjacent goblin ally, who is hit instead.

acts.name: Nimble Escape
acts.text: It can Disengage or Hide as a free action on its Turn.

creatures.name: Orc War Chief
creatures.flav: Gruumsh's fury given a greataxe and a grudge. It leads from the very front, loudly.

acts.name: Gruumsh's Fury
acts.text: Its weapon Attacks deal an extra 4 (1d8) damage. This is already included above.

acts.name: Battle Cry
acts.text: Allies of its choice within Near that can hear it gain Favor on Attacks until the start of its next Turn. It may then Attack once as a free action.

creatures.name: Orc Eye of Gruumsh
creatures.flav: An orc who put out one of their own eyes for their god, and has been rewarded for it.

acts.name: Bless
acts.text: Allies within the area add 1d4 to their Attacks and Saves while the Focus holds.

acts.name: Gruumsh's Fury
acts.text: Its weapon Attacks deal an extra 4 (1d8) damage. This is already included above.

creatures.name: Quaggoth Thonot
creatures.flav: A quaggoth shaman whose grief curdled into something psionic. Krob is one of these, and he is not well.

acts.name: Mind Blast
acts.text: Targets that fail are Dazed (Cd4).

acts.name: Wounded Fury
acts.text: While at 10 HP or fewer, it has Favor on Attacks and its melee Attacks deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

creatures.name: Sephek Kaltro
creatures.flav: Auril's chosen killer, walking the caravan roads to collect the toll she says the living owe her. Torrga Icevein thinks he works for her.

acts.name: Cold Regeneration
acts.text: While the surrounding air is freezing, he regains 5 HP at the start of his Turn. Fire damage suppresses this until the end of his next Turn.

creatures.name: Spellix Romwod
creatures.flav: A gnome wizard who took shelter in the wrong pass and has been entombed in the ice ever since, still mid-argument with himself.

acts.name: Shocking Grasp
acts.text: The target can't take Reactions until the start of its next Turn.

acts.name: Gnome Cunning
acts.text: It has Favor on Saves against Spells.

creatures.name: Specter
creatures.flav: What's left when a soul is denied rest and given nothing to hold onto - not even a body.

acts.name: Life Drain
acts.text: The target's maximum HP is reduced by the damage dealt until it Rests.

acts.name: Incorporeal
acts.text: It moves through Beings and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) damage if it ends its Turn inside one.

acts.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
acts.text: While in sunlight, it has Hinder on Attacks and on sight-based Checks.

creatures.name: Poltergeist
creatures.flav: An invisible spite that expresses itself entirely through other people's furniture.

acts.name: Telekinetic Thrust
acts.text: It hurls a Being or loose object up to 30'. A thrown Being lands Prone and takes the listed damage.

acts.name: Invisible
acts.text: It is permanently Invisible.

acts.name: Incorporeal
acts.text: It moves through Beings and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) damage if it ends its Turn inside one.

creatures.name: Ogre Zombie
creatures.flav: An ogre that died, and then kept the appointment anyway.

acts.name: Undead Fortitude
acts.text: When damage would drop it to 0 HP, it passes [Endure] to drop to 1 HP instead. Fire damage and Critical Hits bypass this.

creatures.name: Icewind Kobold Zombie
creatures.flav: A Termalaine kobold that Xardorok's crystal got to first. It still wears its scraps of hide.

acts.name: Undead Fortitude
acts.text: When damage would drop it to 0 HP, it passes [Endure] to drop to 1 HP instead. Fire damage and Critical Hits bypass this.

creatures.name: Flameskull
creatures.flav: A wizard's skull kept burning as a watchdog. It remembers just enough to be dangerous and nothing at all to be reasoned with.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Rejuvenation
acts.text: If destroyed, it reforms with all its HP in 1 hour unless holy water is poured on its remains or the magic on them is dispelled.

acts.name: Illumination
acts.text: It sheds bright light in a Near radius, and can dim this to a faint glow as a free action.

creatures.name: Brain in a Jar
creatures.flav: Veneranda, once a Netherese wizard of Ythryn, now a preserved brain that has had far too long to think about it.

acts.name: Chill Touch
acts.text: The target can't regain HP until the start of the brain's next Turn.

acts.name: Mind Blast
acts.text: Targets that fail are Dazed (Cd6).

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Detect Sentience
acts.text: It senses the presence and location of any thinking Being within 300', through walls.

creatures.name: Demilich
creatures.flav: Iriolarthas, Arch-Astronomer of Ythryn - a lich so old that only the skull kept up. The gems in its teeth are the souls it hasn't finished.

acts.name: Life Drain
acts.text: Up to three Beings it can see are targeted. It regains HP equal to the total damage dealt.

acts.name: Howl
acts.text: Every Being that hears it must pass [Endure] or drop to 0 HP. On a pass, the Being is Frightened until the end of its next Turn.

acts.name: Vile Curse
acts.text: The target has Hinder on Attacks and Saves, and the demilich has Favor on Attacks against it, until the curse is lifted.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Avoidance
acts.text: When it passes a Save against an effect, it takes no damage from that effect at all.

acts.name: Soul Gems
acts.text: It cannot be permanently destroyed while any of its soul gems remain intact.

creatures.name: Bearded Devil
creatures.flav: A barbazu, all glaive and writhing beard, sent up by Levistus to check on the investment.

acts.name: Beard
acts.text: Target must pass [Endure] or be unable to regain HP (Cd6).

acts.name: Glaive
acts.text: Target must pass [Endure] or take 5 (1d10) damage at the start of each of its Turns from an infernal wound until healed.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Steadfast
acts.text: It can't be Frightened while it can see an ally within Near.

creatures.name: Shadow Demon
creatures.flav: A demon that lost its body and found it didn't much need one.

acts.name: Claws
acts.text: If the demon had Favor on this Attack, it deals 17 (4d6+3) instead.

acts.name: Incorporeal
acts.text: It moves through Beings and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) damage if it ends its Turn inside one.

acts.name: Shadow Stealth
acts.text: In dim light or darkness it can Hide as a free action. In bright light it has Hinder on Attacks.

creatures.name: Night Hag
creatures.flav: Auntie Pinch, Auntie Pillage, or Auntie Plunder. They are sisters, they are hospitable, and you should not eat anything they offer.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Change Shape
acts.text: It takes the form of any Small or Medium humanlike woman, and back. Its statistics are unchanged.

acts.name: Etherealness
acts.text: While holding its heartstone, it steps into or out of the Ethereal Plane.

acts.name: Nightmare Haunting
acts.text: While Ethereal, it touches a sleeping Being. If the contact lasts an hour, the target gains no benefit from the Rest and its maximum HP drops by 5 (1d10) until the haunting ends.

creatures.name: Arcanaloth
creatures.flav: Scrivenscry, a jackal-headed broker of contracts and secrets, who has read everything in Ythryn twice and is bored.

acts.name: Claws
acts.text: Target must pass [Endure] or take a further 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

acts.name: Chain Lightning
acts.text: Arcs to up to three additional Beings within Near of the first target.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Teleport
acts.text: It vanishes and reappears in an empty space it can see within Far.

creatures.name: Red Slaad
creatures.flav: A frog-thing out of Limbo, whose claws plant eggs in people. The Id Ascendant did not crash empty.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: A humanlike target must pass [Endure] or be implanted with a slaad egg.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Regeneration
acts.text: It regains 10 HP at the start of its Turn so long as it has at least 1 HP.

creatures.name: Blue Slaad
creatures.flav: Bone claws, and a disease called chaos phage that turns the victim into another one of these.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: A humanlike target must pass [Endure] or contract chaos phage.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Regeneration
acts.text: It regains 10 HP at the start of its Turn so long as it has at least 1 HP.

creatures.name: Green Slaad
creatures.flav: A slaad that learned to wear a person. It is working very hard on becoming a grey one.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Shapechanger
acts.text: It takes the form of any Small or Medium humanlike, and back. Only its size changes.

acts.name: Regeneration
acts.text: It regains 10 HP at the start of its Turn so long as it has at least 1 HP.

creatures.name: Nothic
creatures.flav: A wizard who looked too long at something they shouldn't have, and got one enormous eye out of the bargain.

acts.name: Weird Insight
acts.text: It can magically wrest one secret from a Being it can see within Near, unless that Being resists with [Will].

creatures.name: Grell
creatures.flav: A floating brain with a beak and ten paralysing tentacles. Termalaine's mine has one, and the miners have stopped going deep.

acts.name: Tentacles
acts.text: Target must pass [Endure] or be Paralyzed (Cd6). It is also Grappling.

creatures.name: Gnome Ceremorph
creatures.flav: A svirfneblin whose head a mind flayer tadpole rewrote badly. Vorryn Q'uuol and Dredavex Sinfiz co-captain the Id Ascendant like this.

acts.name: Tentacles
acts.text: A Medium or smaller target is Grappling, and must pass [Will] or be Dazed while the grapple holds.

acts.name: Mind Blast
acts.text: Targets that fail are Dazed (Cd6).

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Gnome Squidling
creatures.flav: A ceremorphosis that stalled halfway. Rin, Rix, and Zglarrd are pitiable, and still hungry.

acts.name: Tentacles
acts.text: A Medium or smaller target is Grappling, and must pass [Will] or be Dazed while the grapple holds.

acts.name: Mind Tickle
acts.text: Targets that fail are Dazed until the end of their next Turn.

creatures.name: Remorhaz
creatures.flav: The polar worm. It tunnels under the ice and comes up beneath you, and its back glows hot enough to cook whatever it swallows.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: The target is Grappling and Restrained, and the remorhaz can't bite another target until the grapple ends.

acts.name: Swallow
acts.text: It bites a Medium or smaller Being it is Grappling. On a hit, the target is swallowed, is Blinded and Restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's Turns.

acts.name: Heated Body
acts.text: A Being that touches it or hits it with a melee Attack takes 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

acts.name: Ice Tunneler
acts.text: It burrows through ice and packed snow at 20', leaving a tunnel behind it.

creatures.name: Young Remorhaz
creatures.flav: Only twenty feet of it so far. Give it time.

acts.name: Heated Body
acts.text: A Being that touches it or hits it with a melee Attack takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

acts.name: Ice Tunneler
acts.text: It burrows through ice and packed snow at 30', leaving a tunnel behind it.

creatures.name: Phase Spider
creatures.flav: It is not in the room. It will be in the room, briefly, while it bites you.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: Target must pass [Endure] or take a further 18 (4d8) Poison damage and be Paralyzed (Cd6).

acts.name: Ethereal Jaunt
acts.text: As a free action on its Turn it shifts to or from the Ethereal Plane.

acts.name: Web Walker
acts.text: Webbing never slows it.

creatures.name: Spitting Mimic
creatures.flav: A mimic that grew big enough to stop waiting. Ythryn is full of furniture that isn't.

acts.name: Pseudopod
acts.text: In object form, the target also sticks fast and is Grappling.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: False Appearance
acts.text: While it stays still in object form it is indistinguishable from ordinary furniture.

creatures.name: Gnoll Fang of Yeenoghu
creatures.flav: Chyzka, and others like her - a gnoll that ate the right corpse and got promoted by a demon lord.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: Target must pass [Endure] or take a further 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

acts.name: Rampage
acts.text: When it drops a Being to 0 HP with a melee Attack, it may immediately move up to half its Speed and Bite again.

creatures.name: Ice Piercer
creatures.flav: An icicle with an appetite. You will not notice the difference until it is already falling.

acts.name: Drop
acts.text: It falls on a Being directly beneath it, dealing an extra 10 (3d6) Cold damage. On a miss it takes half the falling damage itself.

acts.name: False Appearance
acts.text: While it hangs motionless it is indistinguishable from an ordinary icicle.

creatures.name: Tomb Tapper
creatures.flav: A blind Netherese construct built to hunt magic and break it. It has been tapping through the ice under Ythryn for two thousand years.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: If both Claws hit the same Being, it is dragged adjacent to the tapper's mouth and Bitten.

acts.name: Sledgehammer
acts.text: Thrown, it returns to the tomb tapper's feet at the end of its Turn.

acts.name: Sense Magic
acts.text: It senses magic within Near and can pinpoint any magical Being, object, or area in that range through solid rock.

acts.name: Petrified Death
acts.text: At 0 HP it becomes a lifeless stone statue. Anything it carried is left behind.

creatures.name: Helmed Horror
creatures.flav: Empty armour with a purpose bolted into it. It will guard the door until the door is gone.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Spell Immunity
acts.text: Its creator chose three Spells it cannot be affected by at all.

creatures.name: Living Bigby's Hand
creatures.flav: A spell that outlived its caster and never stopped casting. It is a fist the size of a cart, and it is still following its last order.

acts.name: Force Fist
acts.text: A Large or smaller target is shoved up to 5', and the hand moves with it.

acts.name: Grasping Hand
acts.text: A Huge or smaller Being within reach must pass [Reflex] or be Grappling, taking 15 (2d6+8) damage at the start of each of its Turns. It can't use Force Fist while grappling.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Living Blade of Disaster
creatures.flav: A rip in the world shaped roughly like a sword. It does not so much cut as delete.

acts.name: Force Blade
acts.text: It Crits far more readily than a normal weapon; on a Crit it deals 78 (12d12) instead.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Unfettered
acts.text: It passes through any barrier, including a wall of force.

creatures.name: Living Demiplane
creatures.flav: A door to nowhere that drifts along the walls of Ythryn looking for someone to be a room for.

acts.name: Extradimensional Chamber
acts.text: The first time it enters a Being's space on a Turn, that Being must pass [Reflex] or be pulled into a bare stone room 30' on a side with no exit.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Dimensional Form
acts.text: It shares space with other Beings freely and can squeeze through a one-inch gap, but it must stay attached to a solid surface.

acts.name: Planar Destruction
acts.text: When it is destroyed, everything inside its chamber is expelled into the space it occupied.

creatures.name: Needle Blight
creatures.flav: A shrub that walks, and fires its own pine needles at anything warm.

creatures.name: Awakened Shrub
creatures.flav: A bush that someone taught to talk. It has opinions and almost no way to enforce them.

acts.name: False Appearance
acts.text: While it stays still it is indistinguishable from an ordinary shrub.

creatures.name: Quaggoth Spore Servant
creatures.flav: A quaggoth corpse being walked around by the fungus that ate it.

creatures.name: Tribal Warrior Spore Servant
creatures.flav: One of Caer-Konig's missing hunters, still holding the spear, no longer holding anything else.

creatures.name: Water Weird
creatures.flav: An invisible serpent of animate water, bound to a fountain or a pool and extremely literal about guarding it.

acts.name: Constrict
acts.text: A Medium or smaller target is pulled 5' toward the weird, is Grappling and Restrained, and is being drowned.

acts.name: Invisible in Water
acts.text: It is Invisible while fully immersed.

acts.name: Water Bound
acts.text: It dies if it leaves the water it is bound to, or if that water is destroyed.

creatures.name: Dryad
creatures.flav: Hathowyn, bound to a tree that should not be able to grow this far north, and quietly furious about the cold.

acts.name: Fey Charm
acts.text: The target treats the dryad as a trusted friend until it is harmed by her, or a day passes.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Tree Stride
acts.text: Once on her Turn she may step into one living tree within reach and step out of another within Far.

creatures.name: Fox
creatures.flav: An arctic fox. Ravisin keeps company with them, and they are cannier than they look.

acts.name: Keen Hearing
acts.text: It has Favor on Checks that rely on hearing.

creatures.name: Goat
creatures.flav: Livestock, and in Ten-Towns, occasionally a wall-climbing menace.

acts.name: Charge
acts.text: If it moves at least 20' straight at a target before Ramming it, the Attack deals an extra 2 (1d4) damage and the target must pass [Might] or fall Prone.

creatures.name: Giant Goat
creatures.flav: A goat that could headbutt a sledge apart, and will if provoked.

acts.name: Charge
acts.text: If it moves at least 20' straight at a target before Ramming it, the Attack deals an extra 5 (2d4) damage and the target must pass [Might] or fall Prone.

creatures.name: Mountain Goat
creatures.flav: Kelvin's Cairn is full of them, standing on ledges that have no business holding anything.

acts.name: Sure-Footed
acts.text: It has Favor on Saves against being knocked Prone, and icy ground never slows it.

creatures.name: Raven
creatures.flav: Skelm, Avarice's familiar, is one of these. So is every other bird watching you from the eaves.

acts.name: Mimicry
acts.text: It can imitate simple sounds it has heard. A listener who passes [Will] can tell the sound is an imitation.

creatures.name: Swarm of Ravens
creatures.flav: A black cloud of beaks that has decided you are carrion slightly ahead of schedule.

acts.name: Beaks
acts.text: Only 3 (1d6) once the swarm is at half HP or fewer.

acts.name: Swarm
acts.text: It shares space with other Beings, squeezes through any gap a raven could, and can't regain HP.

creatures.name: Flying Snake
creatures.flav: A winged serpent kept as a curiosity in Easthaven and Targos. It bites far above its weight.

acts.name: Flyby
acts.text: It doesn't provoke Attacks when it flies out of reach.

creatures.name: Giant Vulture
creatures.flav: Patient, ugly, and clever enough to help a fight along when it's going the right way.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Being that has another of its allies adjacent to it.

creatures.name: Plesiosaurus
creatures.flav: Something very old still living in Maer Dualdon, which the Bremen fishers would rather you didn't confirm.

acts.name: Hold Breath
acts.text: It can hold its breath for an hour.

creatures.name: Weasel
creatures.flav: Zelennor, Nass Lantomir's arctic familiar, and every other small thing in the snow with teeth.

acts.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
acts.text: It has Favor on Checks that rely on hearing or smell.

creatures.name: Seal
creatures.flav: Food, company, or an obstacle, depending on who is looking at it.

acts.name: Hold Breath
acts.text: It can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

creatures.name: Walrus
creatures.flav: Two thousand pounds of blubber and tusk that would prefer you left the ice floe.

acts.name: Hold Breath
acts.text: It can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

creatures.name: Giant Walrus
creatures.flav: Ukuma is one of these, and he can talk. The others cannot, and are no less dangerous for it.

acts.name: Hold Breath
acts.text: It can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

creatures.name: Hare
creatures.flav: An arctic hare. Almost entirely a way for something else to get a meal.

acts.name: Escape
acts.text: It can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a free action on its Turn.

creatures.name: Knucklehead Trout
creatures.flav: The fish Ten-Towns is built on. The bony skull carves beautifully, and Ol' Bitey is the biggest ever landed.

acts.name: Water Breathing
acts.text: It can breathe only underwater.

creatures.name: Octopus
creatures.flav: A small cold-water octopus, mostly interested in not being seen.

acts.name: Tentacles
acts.text: The target is Grappling.

acts.name: Ink Cloud
acts.text: Underwater, it fills its space and everything adjacent with ink, Blinding those inside, then Dashes as a free action.

creatures.name: Awakened White Moose
creatures.flav: Ravisin's guardian, white as the tundra and considerably smarter than a moose ought to be.

acts.name: Charge
acts.text: If it moves at least 20' straight at a target before hitting it with Antlers, the Attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) damage and the target must pass [Might] or fall Prone.

creatures.name: Young Griffon (Tiny)
creatures.flav: A griffon chick. It is fluff, it is loud, and its mother is nearby.

creatures.name: Young Griffon (Small)
creatures.flav: Half-grown, entirely convinced it is full-grown.

creatures.name: Young Griffon (Medium)
creatures.flav: Nearly a griffon, and already able to carry off a goat.

creatures.name: Chimeric Baboon
creatures.flav: One of the Arch-Astronomer's experiments. Its bite has been made venomous, for no reason anyone can now ask about.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: Includes an extra 3 (1d6) Poison damage from its altered glands.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Being that has another of its allies adjacent to it.

creatures.name: Chimeric Cat
creatures.flav: A cat that was given eyeless sight. It navigates a dark room better than you navigate a lit one.

acts.name: Tremorsense
acts.text: It senses everything touching the ground within Near, even through walls.

creatures.name: Chimeric Fox
creatures.flav: Its fur shifts colour to match whatever is behind it.

acts.name: Chimeric Creation
acts.text: Its fur shifts to match its surroundings, giving it Favor on Checks to hide.

creatures.name: Chimeric Hare
creatures.flav: Someone gave a hare wings. It has not stopped being a hare about it.

acts.name: Escape
acts.text: It can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a free action on its Turn.

creatures.name: Chimeric Rat
creatures.flav: Gills, iridescent scales, and the ability to breathe both air and water. Still a rat.

acts.name: Chimeric Creation
acts.text: It breathes air and water equally well.

creatures.name: Chimeric Weasel
creatures.flav: Its eyes throw off bright light. It cannot turn them off, and it is not happy about that.

acts.name: Chimeric Creation
acts.text: Its eyes shed bright light in a Near radius and dim light for a Near radius beyond that.

creatures.name: Dragon, Hatchling - Silver
creatures.flav: A silver wyrmling, curious about people in a way its white cousins never are.

acts.name: Paralyzing Breath
acts.text: Targets that fail are Paralyzed (Cd6).
